form_sections_select_published.name: form_sections_select_published
form_sections_select_published.using: exists (select 1 from public.forms f where f.id = form_id and f.status = 'published' and f.deleted_at is null)

question_options_select_published.name: question_options_select_published
question_options_select_published.using:
exists (
    select 1
    from public.questions q
    join public.forms f on f.id = q.form_id
    where q.id = question_id
      and f.status = 'published'
      and f.deleted_at is null
  )

questions_select_published.name: questions_select_published
questions_select_published.using: exists (select 1 from public.forms f where f.id = form_id and f.status = 'published' and f.deleted_at is null)

answers_select_own.name: answers_select_own
answers_select_own.using:
exists (
    select 1 from submissions s
    where s.id = answers.submission_id and s.user_id = (select auth.uid())
  )
